description: This file defines the CameraController actor in Swift, responsible for managing camera and microphone access, capturing photos and video clips, listing available camera devices, and exporting media. It includes methods for taking snapshots, recording clips, device enumeration, permission handling, and utility functions for media processing.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling photo capture callbacks from AVCapturePhotoOutput.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling recorded movie file callbacks from AVCaptureFileOutput.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Asynchronous method to take a photo with specified parameters, returning image format, base64 data, and dimensions.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Asynchronous method to record a video clip with specified parameters, returning format, base64 data, duration, and audio presence.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available video capture devices with their details.
